description: Mass spec calculator — Mass spectrometry helper for a molecular formula: exact monoisotopic mass, average molar mass, nominal mass, isotope pattern (M, M+1, M+2... with relative abundances from IUPAC isotope data, so Cl/Br clusters show up), common ESI adduct m/z values ([M+H]+, [M+Na]+, [M+K]+, [M+NH4]+, [M+2H]2+, [M-H]-, [M+Cl]-, [M+HCOO]-, [M+CH3COO]-), rings-plus-double-bonds and nitrogen-rule check. Pass mz= (observed m/z) to match it against every adduct with ppm and mDa error (tolerance_ppm= default 10). Optional mode=positive|negative|both, charge=. Supports brackets and hydrates (CuSO4*5H2O). Elements: H Li B C N O F Na Mg Al Si P S Cl K Ca Fe Cu Zn Se Br I. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_mass_spec
